definitions.ask: Should conflict copies whose `_conflicts/` path is gitignored be force-added so they sync like Markdown copies?
definitions.why: Every sync_conflicts.md entry then names a file that exists on every host

choices.label: Stage every conflict copy with `git add -f`, so ignored copies are committed and reach every host
Keep ignored copies untracked on the resolving host; their sync_conflicts.md line says host-local

definitions.ask: Should vault-sync swap its dead `bob notify` call for a macOS banner on conflicts and on a new halt?
definitions.why: athena and apollo are headless, so no banner would have reached Bryan in either incident

choices.label: The Mac gets an osascript banner per conflict cycle and per new halt; Linux hosts stay log-only
Delete the dead call; a halt shows only in last_error, the service log, and nightly's summary

definitions.ask: Should the implementer roll the fix out on athena (install bob, set the repo config, add the union rule to the vault)?
definitions.why: Both loops ran on athena, and the report calls the config change its fix-now step

choices.label: Install bob, set both autoDetach keys, and add the journal union rule to ~/bob/.gitattributes
Ship only code, tests, and docs; the final report lists the host and vault steps for Bryan

definitions.ask: Should the implementer delete the incident's leftover ~/bob/_conflicts copies after checking each against its source?
definitions.why: Each copy is checked first, and the incidents' data already lives in the tracked files

choices.label: Delete each copy only after it matches its source; keep and report any copy that fails the check
Leave _conflicts/ untouched; the final report lists the cleanup commands
